name: photobooth-desktop
description: Photobooth desktop app built with Electrobun

scripts.setup:desktop: bash -c 'D=$(find build -name launcher -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1) && P=$(dirname "$D")/.. && I=$(find "$P" -name icon.svg 2>/dev/null | head -1) && mkdir -p ~/.local/share/applications && cat src/mainview/assets/photobooth.desktop | sed "s|%%LAUNCHER%%|$D|g; s|%%ICON%%|$I|g" > ~/.local/share/applications/photobooth.desktop && echo "Desktop file installed: ~/.local/share/applications/photobooth.desktop"'
